design.inference: Exact historical application boundary: per-query jax.jit(model.rollout), inputs jnp.asarray with ambient x64 disabled, float32 output. No batching change, clipping, substep change, parameter update, fitting, gradients, native rollout, controller or seed sweep.
design.model_correspondence: All shared-v1 parameters and existing norms bitwise equal bounded_initial; only six motion_bound_scale values added. Boundedterminal preserves every norm and changes learned parameters. Unboundedrefined preserves shared norms. Verify fingerprints and exact array equality, not NPZ byte equality.
design.scope: All189queries are previously inspected. The archived fresh label is remapped to known-pilot; no fresh generalization claim.

kind: No-fit diagnostic on previously inspected Dart evidence; no promotion

measurements.growth_interpretation: 1000m/s or1000rad/s is a catastrophic-growth diagnostic only, not stability or application adequacy. All-time full-state finiteness plus both maxima<1000 describes absence of observed catastrophic growth in this known set only.
measurements.paired: For every contrast and scope/kind/horizon/statistic/group, retain all planned and truth-eligible counts and both failure counts; report common-finite count/fraction and balanced common-finite physical RMSE/ratio. Undefined empty subsets remain null. Never interpret conditional ratios as full-population accuracy.
measurements.response: Signed branch prediction minus same-model factual prediction, compared with signed branch truth minus factual truth; intersect truth validity. Require exact parent/origin/scope/history/factual association.
measurements.scoring: Float64 physical component MSE in each horizon/group/statistic; equal branches within origin, origins within parent, then parents within each scope/kind cell. No pooling the scopes. Full eligible-cohort RMSE undefined if any eligible prediction fails; preserve planned/eligible/failure/parent counts.
measurements.trajectory: Full canonical-state finite flag and first nonfinite step/time, full finite-prefix length; velocity/rate norms computed after float64 cast, per-group max over finite norms and first finite norm>=10,100,1000,1000000. Preserve failures and extreme finite outputs independently of response subtraction.

named_gap: Separate feature-conditioning benefit from refinement damage

Keep completed source and evidence immutable.

proof.historical: All378shared-v1/unbounded-refined predictions must reproduce archived arrays exactly including shape/dtype/equal_nan. Record all mismatches without changing code, tolerance or continuing with an altered comparator.
proof.independent: Separately implemented NumPy reduction of raw saved predictions/truth. Require exact identities/counts/finite flags and floats within rtol1e-12/atol1e-15.
proof.replay: One exact756prediction replay from unchanged saved inputs/models, plus exact metric/diagnostic reduction equality. No refitting.

If reference reproduction fails, retain bounded diagnostic results as inconclusive for exact comparative attribution; never repeat a completed call to repair it.
qualification.interpretation: Describe conditioning versus subsequent optimization on known data. No heldout population accuracy, controller, derivative, calibration or arbitrary-system qualification. Any future model change or fresh evaluation requires its own frozen iteration.
